title: database-modeling-skill Input
description: Input contract for producing Prisma_Schema_Proposal.prisma and DB_Schema.sql

architecture_path.description: Path to completed Architecture.md. Domain entities must be enumerated.

prd_path.description: Path to approved PRD.md. Used to extract data requirements, retention rules, and privacy constraints.

security_classification_path.description: Optional path to existing Security_Strategy.md or Data_Classification.md from security-architecture-skill. If provided, classification annotations are taken from there.

existing_schema_path.description: Optional path to existing Prisma schema being extended. If provided, the skill extends rather than creates from scratch.

soft_delete_required.description: Whether the PRD requires soft deletes (data retention or audit trail for user-visible entities).

id_strategy.description: Primary key generation strategy for user-facing models. Use autoincrement only for internal/audit tables.
